work.objective: 验证 ADR 0035 内容验收的语义归一化。
context: 只输出 reports/adr-0035.md。acceptance semantic prompt literals：commandPath=`reports/adr-0035.md`；deliverablePath=`reports/adr-0035.md`；minimumDeliverableCount=`1`；minimumLineCount=`4`；maximumBytes=`4096`；required_all[0]=`reviewdecision binds digest`；required_all[1]=`four-dimensional gate`；required_any[0][0]=`authority boundary`；required_any[0][1]=`trust boundary`；forbidden[0]=`unsafe override`。authority boundary 与 trust boundary 是允许的等义表述；unsafe override 的正确替代语义是所有 gate fail closed。
constraints: 只修改 reports/adr-0035.md；不提交、不推送；不读取 .marshal。
若某操作被 permission 拒绝，不得重试该路径，改用允许路径内的等价输入。
nonGoals: 不改变 Marshal Core 契约

argv: from pathlib import Path; import unicodedata; p=Path('reports/adr-0035.md'); s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'); n=unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',s).casefold(); required_all=['reviewdecision binds digest','four-dimensional gate']; required_any=[['authority boundary','trust boundary']]; forbidden=['unsafe override']; assert len(s.splitlines()) >= 4; assert len(s.encode('utf-8')) <= 4096; assert not [x for x in required_all if x not in n]; assert not [g for g in required_any if not any(x in n for x in g)]; assert not [x for x in forbidden if x in n]
